answer: Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ripple. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
